_meta.notes: Chunk-file/listing label says 'June'; the FORM checks 'Seven days before a primary election' - form governs, matching the chunk file. Cover 'Office' reads 'AT LARGE / COUNTY COUNCIL B' and party 'GOP' - agrees with index.csv (County Council, At-Large B). THE COVER'S 'Office Sought / District Number' ROW IS COVERED BY THE COUNTY'S BLACK BAR, so office_sought is taken from the top-row 'Office' field and district_number is honestly blank (the 2008-era two-office-box precedent). Neither amendment box is ticked - is_amendment BLANK. Cover signature date 6-20-16 while every schedule/summary page header is dated 6-21-16; clerk stamp RECEIVED IN OFFICE JUN 21 2016 - both dates kept, report_date is the cover signature. p6/p7 are photocopy-degraded (black scan edge, speckle) but fully legible. The contributor address column is black-barred on ALL THREE Schedule A pages - every donor_city/donor_state is blank as 'redacted at source', NEVER as 'left blank by the filer'. Occupation/Employer survives the bar on every row and is captured verbatim. The same three IN-KIND items (Ella Rose Floral 2,898.00, Snelgrove Travel Center 3,020.00, SLCo Republican Party 500.00, all 6-18-16) appear on BOTH Schedule A and Schedule B - that is the filer's own double entry of an in-kind item as both a contribution and an expenditure, and both sides' printed totals include them.
